description:
Port 4 tool-management extensions:
- tools.ts → Tools: getAllTools, setActiveTools, getActiveTools, appendEntry for custom entries
- dynamic-tools.ts → DynamicTools: runtime tool registration on session_start, promptSnippet/promptGuidelines fields
- permission-gate.ts → PermissionGate: tool_call event blocking with interactive ctx.ui.select
- protected-paths.ts → ProtectedPaths: tool_call blocking based on file path patterns

Exercises the tool management and interactive UI context APIs. Expect issues around setActiveTools/getActiveTools and ui.select.
title: Example extensions wave 2: tools & permissions (tools, dynamic-tools, permission-gate, protected-paths)
